caption: The drawing shows a single, vertically-oriented object positioned in the center of a beige or off-white background. The object itself is an oval-shaped carving featuring a symmetrical, stylized face with geometric elements. The face consists of two circular shapes for eyes, a broad nose, and a heart-like form at the base that may represent the mouth or chin. The surface of the object is decorated with patterns including zigzags and leaf-like motifs, which outline the face and fill the surrounding space. The carving appears to be made of wood and is colored in shades of brown with subtle highlights, giving it a three-dimensional appearance. Beneath the object, the text "CHARLOTTE ISLANDS" is printed in a small, uppercase font. The rest of the composition is empty, creating a stark contrast between the intricately decorated object and the plain background.
title: Pa. German Block Used in Pressing and Steaming
